## Exact Tool Call Sequence

```json
[
  {
    "step": 1,
    "tool": "read_file",
    "params": {
      "path": "config.yaml"
    },
    "reason": "Read config.yaml to extract the database.host value"
  },
  {
    "step": 2,
    "tool": "execute",
    "params": {
      "command": "grep -A5 'database:' config.yaml | grep 'host:' | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\"'"
    },
    "reason": "Parse the database.host value from the YAML content reliably via shell"
  },
  {
    "step": 3,
    "tool": "execute",
    "params": {
      "command": "ping -c 4 $(grep -A5 'database:' config.yaml | grep 'host:' | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\"') 2>&1"
    },
    "reason": "Ping the extracted host (4 packets), capturing both stdout and stderr"
  },
  {
    "step": 4,
    "tool": "execute",
    "params": {
      "command": "echo \"HEALTH CHECK REPORT\n==========================================\nTimestamp : $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')\nHost      : $(grep -A5 'database:' config.yaml | grep 'host:' | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\"')\n------------------------------------------\nPing Results:\n$(ping -c 4 $(grep -A5 'database:' config.yaml | grep 'host:' | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\"') 2>&1)\n==========================================\""
    },
    "reason": "Compose the full report content with timestamp, host, and ping output in one shell command"
  },
  {
    "step": 5,
    "tool": "write_file",
    "params": {
      "path": "health-check.txt",
      "content": "<output from step 4>"
    },
    "reason": "Write the composed report to health-check.txt"
  }
]
```

---

## What Each Step Does & Why

| Step | Tool | Purpose |
|------|------|---------|
| 1 | `read_file` | Safely read raw `config.yaml` content |
| 2 | `execute` | Shell-parse the `database.host` key precisely |
| 3 | `execute` | Ping the host, capture full output + errors |
| 4 | `execute` | Assemble the timestamped report string |
| 5 | `write_file` | Persist report to `health-check.txt` |

---

## Expected Output in `health-check.txt`

```
HEALTH CHECK REPORT
==========================================
Timestamp : 2024-07-15 14:32:07 UTC
Host      : db.example.com
------------------------------------------
Ping Results:
PING db.example.com (203.0.113.42): 56 data bytes
64 bytes from 203.0.113.42: icmp_seq=0 ttl=56 time=12.4 ms
64 bytes from 203.0.113.42: icmp_seq=1 ttl=56 time=11.9 ms
64 bytes from 203.0.113.42: icmp_seq=2 ttl=56 time=12.1 ms
64 bytes from 203.0.113.42: icmp_seq=3 ttl=56 time=12.3 ms

--- db.example.com ping statistics ---
4 packets transmitted, 4 received, 0% packet loss
round-trip min/avg/max/stddev = 11.9/12.2/12.4/0.2 ms
==========================================
```

> **Note:** Steps 3 and 4 re-parse the host from `config.yaml` for idempotency. In a real agentic loop, the host extracted in step 2 would be interpolated into subsequent commands rather than re-parsed each time.
